name: Job search
description: The roles we're going for, the companies behind them, who we know there, and what happens next.

company.description: An organisation we might work for.

role.description: A job we are interested in or have applied for, and how far along it is.

applied.label: Applied on
applied.description: the day the application went in

at.description: the company hiring for this role

step.description: The next thing to do for a role: a follow-up, an interview, a task to send back.

about.description: the role this step moves forward

contact.description: Someone we know, or have spoken to, at a company.

add-company.title: Add a company
add-company.description: Add an organisation you might want to work for.

add-role.title: Add a role
add-role.description: Add a job you are interested in, before choosing its company.

add-role-here.title: Add a role at this company
add-role-here.description: Add a job this company is hiring for, by title, with a link to the advert if you have one.

log-application.title: Log an application
log-application.description: Record a role you applied for today, by title.

apply.title: Mark as applied
apply.description: Say you sent the application today; the clock for a next step starts now.

start-interviewing.title: Interviewing
start-interviewing.refusal: {title} is not waiting on an interview
start-interviewing.description: Say this role has moved to interviews.

got-offer.title: Got an offer
got-offer.description: Say this role made you an offer.

accept-offer.title: Accept
accept-offer.refusal: {title} has not made an offer yet
accept-offer.description: Say you accepted this role's offer.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: Say this role turned you down; it drops out of view but is not deleted.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Say you pulled out of this role; it drops out of view but is not deleted.

set-salary.title: Set the salary
set-salary.description: Record the salary advertised or offered.

add-next-step.title: Plan the next step
add-next-step.description: Add the next thing to do for this role, like a follow-up email, with a due date if there is one.

set-due.title: Change the due date
set-due.description: Set or move the date a step is due.

attach-step.title: Attach to a role
attach-step.description: Say which role a step is for.
attach-step.fromTheOtherEnd: Attach one of our steps to this role

file-role.title: Set the company
file-role.description: Say which company is hiring for a role.
file-role.fromTheOtherEnd: Add one of our roles to this company

add-contact.title: Add a contact
add-contact.description: Add someone you know or have spoken to.

add-contact-here.title: Add someone we know here
add-contact-here.description: Add a person who works at this company, by name, with their email and job if you have them.

set-workplace.title: Set where they work
set-workplace.description: Say which company a contact works at.
set-workplace.fromTheOtherEnd: Add one of our contacts here

unfile-role.title: Clear the company
unfile-role.description: Say a role is not at the company it was filed under.
unfile-role.fromTheOtherEnd: Take one of our roles off this company

detach-step.title: Detach from its role
detach-step.description: Take a step off the role it was for.
detach-step.fromTheOtherEnd: Detach a step from this role

clear-workplace.title: Clear where they work
clear-workplace.description: Say a contact no longer works at the company they were filed under.
clear-workplace.fromTheOtherEnd: Say someone no longer works here

application-has-next-step.title: A live application always has a next step
application-has-next-step.description: Applications go quiet; a week without a planned step means it is time to follow up.
application-has-next-step.require: exists(in('about') where done != true) || !present(applied) || days(applied, today()) < 7
application-has-next-step.says: {title} has had no next step for a week

step-on-time.title: Steps are done by their due date

grants.describe: Owners and editors may do everything; viewers can look.
